validation_limits: No system clipboard access or terminal clipboard execution.

records.behavior: TUI summary-save lookup supplies the new startup_config_cwd argument explicitly for the config panel.
records.decodex_consumer: No Decodex caller uses the TUI config panel helper.
validation_limits: The fix adjusts one TUI call site and adds no changed test.

records.behavior: The native context renderer omits whitespace-only initial permission descriptions while still rendering retained policy updates when present.
records.decodex_consumer: Decodex forwards exact permission settings and observes native approvals. Prompt text is emitted by Codex and is separate from actual permission enforcement.
validation_limits: Existing permission and helper execution checks apply to native enforcement at the retained boundary.

records.behavior: The TUI workspaces can dock Agent Command Center alongside the transcript, switching focus independently while keeping the selected row and queued refreshes.
records.decodex_consumer: Decodex uses its GPUI workspace and current native catalog integration, with no TUI workspace or command center dependency.
validation_limits: No new GPUI coordination surface is selected.

records.behavior: TUI Command Center maps mouse selection and actions onto currently valid typed list entries and retains search paging and retry behavior.
records.decodex_consumer: Decodex uses its own native conversation navigation over GPUI and does not consume TUI painted rows or hit-testing.
validation_limits: No corresponding application UI change or TUI execution.

records.behavior: Codex recognizes the Orca integrated terminal and projects its terminal name, link/pet capabilities and TUI preferences.
records.decodex_consumer: The Decodex macOS desktop app and app-server wire clients do not use Codex TUI terminal detection.
validation_limits: No terminal integration or terminal launch selected.

records.behavior: TUI clipboard paste falls back to text after an unavailable image read and guards submission while an owned paste is still pending. Outdated input invalidates the pending read.
records.decodex_consumer: The Decodex GPUI composer and attachments do not use this TUI clipboard worker or pending submission guard.
validation_limits: No system clipboard, TUI or installed desktop acceptance.

scope: Consecutive official first-parent delta with local consumer and exact test evidence. Source completeness applies to this observed target.
